title: 大家的公路轮胎多久开裂？
notes: Owner post (2025-02-23): two 28C Chaoyang H486 tires cracked all the way around after fewer than 600 km over five months and five months of storage. A commenter reported the same cracking on an H486 bought in March 2024; a commenter who said they work for the maker is not counted as an owner.
